Invisible AI: Building the Eyes of the Factory

Invisible AI’s platform is used by leading manufacturers including Toyota and spans automotive, heavy equipment, and electronics industries. The system delivers immediate visual feedback to operators within seconds, enabling faster learning and behavior change, while providing factory leadership with complete visual context for coaching and continuous improvement.
Across the Entire Factory Floor

Invisible AI transforms raw visual data into actionable insight by deploying hundreds of intelligent agent cameras across production lines. Each device integrates RealSense D455 depth cameras with onboard AI processing and up to 4TB of storage, functioning as self-contained units that don’t require cloud streaming or coding and can be installed in days, often between shifts.

What began as a tool for immediate return on investment has evolved into a new category: the Factory Operating System. With massive volumes of spatial-temporal data, Invisible AI is becoming the system of record for how factories actually function, enabling manufacturers to design and optimize processes using real data rather than theoretical assumptions throughout the entire workflow lifecycle.
